# `vox-terminal-core`

**Crate:** `vox-terminal-core` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

UI-agnostic terminal+agent engine shared by vox-term (ratatui TUI) and the Axis GUI Console.

## Crate Overview

UI-agnostic terminal + agent engine. Front-ends (ratatui TUI, GUI Console)
render its blocks/events and submit input back. Adapts vox-orchestrator;
never reimplements the agent loop.
